newsitem.title: USA: Master Glaziers holders ok reverse split.
newsitem.headline: Master Glaziers holders ok reverse split.

text.p: Master Glazier's Karate International Inc said Monday that its shareholders approved a one-for-five reverse stock split of its common stock and the sale of five of its karate center locations to affiliates of Tiger Schulmann's Karate.

The company said its holders approved increasing its capital stock to 40 million shares from 15 million shares and the appointment of Moore Stephens PC as its independent certified public accountants.
Additionally, shareholders approved the election of Chief Executive Mark Glazier and two others - Marc Zwetchenbaum and Richard Schechtman - to its board for one-year terms.
Master Glazier's Karate International Inc owns martial arts training centers in New York, New Jersey and Pennsylvania.
